subject: fixed Nesterov ctor in gm/commad + rng args

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: fixed Nesterov ctor in gm/commad + rng args
parts:
I just pushed a two-part fix to gm/command.

1. I added the rng as an argument in write_csv in the commands.
Don't know how that went missing after my commit yesterday.

2. Now I'm getting an issue with the Nesterov optimization constructor.
The problem is that the call in gm/command:

stan::optimization::NesterovGradient ng(model, params_r, params_i,
std::cout);

doesn't match the declaration:

NesterovGradient(stan::model::prob_grad& model,
const std::vector<double>& params_r,
const std::vector<int>& params_i,
double epsilon0 = -1,
std::ostream* output_stream = 0) :

You can't omit an intermediate variable and the std::cout needs to
be a pointer. This worked:

stan::optimization::NesterovGradient ng(model, params_r, params_i,
-1.0, &std::cout);

so I pushed the change. I hope that's what was intended here.

- Bob
